main_text.p: post ea, quæ jam emisi, parata habeo & scriben- da, quæ restant, rursum me verto ; unde hac o- pellà abduƈtus fui. Sibilos & clamores ca- lumniatorum, quibus lacessor, non curo, nec pereos ab optimo proposito abduci me, aut in cursu turbari sino. Per me licebit hominibus hujusmodi, ex cohorte Medij Thessali, ingenio ac genio suo obsequi, & hoc scriptionis genere atque hac arte se pascere, stylumque & facun- diam suam exercere. Licebit quoque, quos tondere se jactant, ut tondeant, quamdiu se, ad quos id pertinet, tonderi patientur. Non enim hoc ad me, Me optima sustentat optimæ vo- luntatis, qui patriæ gratis in hoc studij genere servio, conscientia. Ea cum approbatione bo- norum ingenio, doctrina, judicio præstantium sat magna mihi merces. Vale, & quod hic do, boni consule. Erraris ignosce.

page.notes: Transcription is from the scan as read; the first line is set partly in a faded area and the word "Me" in "hoc ad me, Me optima" and "sustentat" are uncertain. Possible misreadings: "sustentat" (may be "sustentat"); "hic do" may read "hic do,". Words at line ends in the middle of the page are read from the scan; the woodcut ornament is not transcribed. The word "Medij" and "Thessali" are read as printed.
